articles.title_en: Methodology Matters: A Careful Meta-Analysis of Climate Damages
articles.title_cn: 方法论很重要：对气候损害进行仔细的荟萃分析
articles.abstract_en: Environmental economists widely use meta-regression to combine estimates from multiple studies to strive for consensus Nelson and Kennedy (Environ Resour Econ 42(3):345–77, 2009). Despite its wide-scale adoption, climate economists using meta-regression to synthesize climate damage estimates find a wide range of outcomes when analyzing impacts at the global scale, as represented by the primary and alternative damage functions in Barrage and Nordhaus (Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 121(13):e2312030121, 2024). Conducting a new search and selection procedure, we update the underlying data from Howard and Sterner (Environ Resour Econ 68(1)197–225, 2017), the study which represents the upper end of this range. Using a slightly modified version of the Howard and Sterner (Environ Resour Econ 68(1)197–225, 2017) model enabled by our larger dataset, we estimate non-catastrophic damages to be between 3.2% and 9.2% of GDP for a 3 °C increase depending on whether growth effects are included. This range increases to 12.5% and 18.5% with the inclusion of catastrophic impacts. Using probabilistic weights for these uncertain structural assumptions, our best estimate is between 7.1% and 12.6% depending on how narrowly we define catastrophic damages. We explore the causes of the disparity between our results and Barrage and Nordhaus (Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 121(13):e2312030121, 2024), and find that it stems primarily from differences in data search, selection, and weighting (with our study including more independent studies and a wider set of estimation strategies) and our decision to include methodological controls. To resolve the disparity, it is critical to adjust for methodological differences between studies, as the underlying mix of estimation methodologies is non-random and may capture different, but overlapping, impacts of climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境经济学家广泛使用元回归来结合多项研究的估计，以争取 Nelson 和 Kennedy 的共识（Environ Resour Econ 42（3）：345-77，2009）。尽管其被广泛采用，但使用元回归来综合气候损害估计的气候经济学家在分析全球范围的影响时发现了各种各样的结果，如 Barrage 和 Nordhaus 中的主要和替代损害函数所示（Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 121（13）：e2312030121，2024）。通过进行新的搜索和选择程序，我们更新了 Howard 和 Sterner 的基础数据（Environ Resour Econ 68(1)197-225, 2017），该研究代表了该范围的上限。使用我们较大的数据集启用的 Howard 和 Sterner（Environ Resour Econ 68（1）197-225，2017）模型的稍微修改版本，我们估计，根据是否包括增长效应，3 °C 增加时非灾难性损害将在 GDP 的 3.2% 和 9.2% 之间。该范围增加到 12.5% 和 18.5%，其中包括灾难性影响。对这些不确定的结构假设使用概率权重，我们的最佳估计介于 7.1% 和 12.6% 之间，具体取决于我们定义灾难性损害的范围。我们探讨了我们的结果与 Barrage 和 Nordhaus (Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 121(13):e2312030121, 2024) 之间差异的原因，发现它主要源于数据搜索、选择和加权方面的差异（我们的研究包括更多的独立研究和更广泛的估计策略）以及我们纳入方法控制的决定。为了解决这种差异，调整研究之间的方法差异至关重要，因为估计方法的基本组合是非随机的，并且可能捕获不同但重叠的气候变化影响。

articles.title_en: Indirect Land use Change Mechanisms: Tests from Biofuel Mandates and Pantropical Agriculture
articles.title_cn: 间接土地利用变化机制：来自生物燃料指令和泛热带农业的检验
articles.abstract_en: Agricultural supply and demand shocks can indirectly cause environmental damages as they propagate across space, time and commodity markets according to mechanisms that have been extensively theorized and simulated, but barely verified empirically. In this paper, I propose a mapping of these indirect land use change (ILUC) mechanisms to major commercial crops. Within this framework, I derive empirical tests of ILUC mechanisms formally, based on interaction effects of local crop-specific conditions and global market shocks. I can run some of these tests in a natural experiment by leveraging the pre-determined nature of the biofuel mandate agenda under the second Renewable Fuel Standard program (RFS2) - one of the largest shocks on global agricultural markets. This detects empirical signals of ILUC for eight commercial crops across the tropics, yielding four results. First, some estimates corroborate a land use displacement mechanism specifically. Second, mechanisms transferring expansion incentives across crops in the same – rather than opposite – direction prevail, including in most critical deforestation contexts. Third, other estimates nevertheless support mechanisms turning maize demand increments into lower incentives to expand other crops. Fourth, ILUC mechanisms occur on both global and domestic markets and their influences vary across the tropics. Overall, these results warn about the reality of ILUC, and partially identify how it occurs.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业供需冲击可以通过空间、时间和商品市场传播，间接造成环境损害，其机制已被广泛理论化和模拟，但几乎未得到实证验证。在本文中，我提出了这些间接土地利用变化（ILUC）机制向主要商业作物的映射。在此框架内，我基于当地作物特定条件与全球市场冲击的交互效应，正式推导出ILUC机制的实证检验。我可以通过利用第二可再生燃料标准计划（RFS2）下生物燃料指令议程的预定性质——全球农业市场上最大的冲击之一——在自然实验中运行其中一些检验。这检测了热带地区八种商业作物的ILUC实证信号，得出四个结果。第一，一些估计特别证实了土地利用置换机制。第二，将扩张激励转移至同一方向——而非相反方向——作物的机制占主导，包括在大多数关键的森林砍伐情境中。第三，其他估计仍然支持将玉米需求增量转化为降低其他作物扩张激励的机制。第四，ILUC机制同时发生在全球和国内市场上，其影响在热带地区各不相同。总体而言，这些结果警示了ILUC的现实性，并部分识别了其发生方式。

articles.title_en: Chilling Sunsets: Climate Distances and Later-Life Mortality of Immigrants
articles.title_cn: 寒冷日落：气候距离与移民晚年死亡率
articles.abstract_en: Previous research suggests that immigrants sort into environments that resemble their country of origin. However, fewer studies have examined whether this similarity/dissimilarity affects health outcomes. In this paper, we address this question using Social Security Administration death records linked to the full count 1940 census. We explore the effect of temperature distance, i.e. the difference between the average temperature of an immigrant’s birth country and US county of residence, during midlife on later-life longevity. We find that a 5.5 °C change in temperature distance, equivalent to the mean of the sample, is associated with 3.3 months lower longevity. We find that these effects are largely driven by low-educated individuals and those in weather-related occupations for whom climate-specific skills play an important role. Further, we find comparable effects when we turn our focus on cross-county internal migrants of US-born individuals. We discuss the policy implication of these results in light of expected climate-driven migration in the population of immigrants in the US population in the coming decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 先前的研究表明，移民会选择定居在与原籍国环境相似的地方。然而，较少有研究考察这种相似性/差异性是否影响健康结果。在本文中，我们利用与社会保障管理局死亡记录相关联的1940年全量人口普查数据来探讨这一问题。我们研究了中年时期温度距离（即移民出生国平均温度与美国居住县平均温度之间的差异）对晚年寿命的影响。我们发现，温度距离每变化5.5°C（相当于样本均值），与寿命缩短3.3个月相关。我们发现这些效应主要由低教育程度个体和从事与天气相关职业的个体驱动，对于这些人群，气候特定技能起着重要作用。此外，当我们关注美国本土出生个体的跨县内部迁移时，也发现了类似效应。我们讨论了这些结果在未来几十年美国移民人口中预期气候驱动迁移背景下的政策含义。

articles.title_en: Adaptation to Catastrophic Events with Two Layers of Uncertainty: Central Planner Perspective
articles.title_cn: 两层不确定性下对灾难性事件的适应：中央计划者视角
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal adaptation to extreme climate events in a setup where events are dynamically uncertain and the decision maker does not know the true probabilities of events. We analyze different policy decision rules minimizing expected welfare losses for sites with different expected damages from the catastrophic event. We show under which conditions it is optimal to wait before implementing prevention measures in order to obtain more information about the underlying probabilistic process. This waiting time crucially depends on the information set of the planner and the implemented learning procedure. We study different learning procedures of the planner, ranging from simple perfect learning to two-layers Bayesian updating in the form of Dirichlet mixture processes. This latter, to the best of our knowledge, is a novel tool in the climate adaptation economics literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在事件动态不确定且决策者不知道事件真实概率的情况下，对极端气候事件的最优适应。我们分析了在不同政策决策规则下，针对具有不同预期灾难损失的站点，最小化预期福利损失的政策。我们展示了在何种条件下，为了获取更多关于潜在概率过程的信息，在实施预防措施之前等待是最优的。这一等待时间关键取决于计划者的信息集和所实施的学习程序。我们研究了计划者的不同学习程序，从简单的完美学习到以狄利克雷混合过程形式的两层贝叶斯更新。据我们所知，后者是气候适应经济学文献中的一种新颖工具。

articles.title_en: Optimal Allocation of Abatement Effort Under Political Constraints: The Economic Cost of Delaying Sectoral and Economy-Wide Climate Policies
articles.title_cn: 政治约束下的减排努力最优配置：延迟部门级和整体经济气候政策的经济成本
articles.abstract_en: Despite commitments to address climate change, governments face political challenges to implementing first-best policies. These challenges cause policymakers to delay climate action, especially in politically sensitive sectors of the economy. Taking political headwinds as an exogenous constraint, this paper analyzes the cost of delaying climate policies both at a sectoral level and economy-wide. The paper demonstrates that delaying climate action is more expensive than distorting the allocation of effort across sectors. More precisely, it is more expensive to delay economy-wide climate policies than to delay action only in a subset of sensitive sectors, which is, in turn, more expensive than immediately implementing a less ambitious policy (e.g., a lower-than-optimal carbon price) in sensitive sectors. The paper then uses numerical simulations to show that sectoral emissions rates, rather than abatement costs, drive the cost of delaying climate action in a given sector. This is because delaying action in sectors with high emissions rates causes a large distortion in the allocation of effort across the rest of the economy, which increases costs. Failing to capture low cost abatement opportunities does increase policy costs (because it requires doing more in expensive sectors) but this effect is smaller than delaying high emissions sectors. Finally, the paper shows that, in practice, climate action is most expensive to delay in the energy sector, because it possesses both a high emissions rate and a low marginal investment cost. The paper can provide guidance for policymakers navigating the political-economic landscape while still aiming to achieve climate goals.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管承诺应对气候变化，政府在执行最优政策时面临政治挑战。这些挑战导致政策制定者延迟气候行动，尤其是在经济中政治敏感的部门。将政治阻力视为外生约束，本文分析了在部门层面和整体经济层面延迟气候政策的成本。本文证明，延迟气候行动比扭曲跨部门努力配置更为昂贵。更确切地说，延迟整体经济气候政策比仅在敏感部门子集中延迟行动更昂贵，而后者又比在敏感部门立即实施不那么雄心勃勃的政策（例如，低于最优碳价）更昂贵。随后，本文使用数值模拟表明，部门排放率而非减排成本驱动了给定部门延迟气候行动的成本。这是因为在排放率高的部门延迟行动会导致其余经济部门努力配置的较大扭曲，从而增加成本。未能捕捉低成本减排机会确实会增加政策成本（因为它需要在昂贵部门做更多），但这一效应小于延迟高排放部门的影响。最后，本文表明，在实践中，能源部门的气候行动延迟成本最高，因为它既具有高排放率又具有低边际投资成本。本文可为政策制定者在政治经济格局中导航同时仍致力于实现气候目标提供指导。

articles.title_en: Modeling the Evolution of Carbon Intensity: Linking the Solow Model to the Transport Equation
articles.title_cn: 碳强度演变的建模：将索洛模型与输运方程联系起来
articles.abstract_en: While a sustained contraction of global production could lower total carbon emissions, it would hamper economic development in poorer countries, reduce living standards for low-income households in advanced economies, and heighten the risk of social unrest. Therefore, reducing carbon intensity – emissions per unit of output – appears to be the most viable and sustainable path forward. We make two contributions: one empirical and one theoretical. Empirically, we show that the transport equation, a basic partial differential equation from physics, captures well the evolution of the distribution of carbon intensities across major economies since 1995. Theoretically, we show that in an extended Solow model with abatement capital, the distribution of carbon intensity across a continuum of economies follows the dynamics described by the transport equation. Moreover, this theory-backed version remains empirically plausible under standard parameter values. In addition, unlike its empirical counterpart, it enables projections of emissions and temperature increases under various policy scenarios, aligning closely with forecasts by leading institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管全球生产的持续收缩可以降低总碳排放，但这会阻碍较贫穷国家的经济发展，降低发达经济体中低收入家庭的生活水平，并增加社会动荡的风险。因此，降低碳强度——即单位产出的排放量——似乎是可行且可持续的前进路径。我们做出了两项贡献：一项是实证性的，另一项是理论性的。在实证方面，我们展示了输运方程，一个来自物理学的基本偏微分方程，能够很好地捕捉自1995年以来主要经济体碳强度分布的演变。在理论方面，我们展示了在包含减排资本的扩展索洛模型中，连续经济体间的碳强度分布遵循输运方程所描述的动态。此外，这一基于理论的版本在标准参数值下仍然具有实证可行性。另外，与其实证对应版本不同，它能够在各种政策情景下预测排放和温度上升，与主要机构的预测紧密吻合。

articles.title_en: Rising Temperature, Nuanced Effects: Evidence from Seasonal and Sectoral Data
articles.title_cn: 气温上升，效应细微：来自季节与部门数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using quarterly temperature and sectoral value-added data for a large sample of advanced economies (AEs) and emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs), this paper uncovers nuanced effects of temperature on economic activity. For EMDEs, hotter spring and summer temperatures reduce growth in real value-added of manufacturing, and most significantly, of agriculture, while a warmer winter boosts it. For advanced countries (AEs), a hotter spring hurts growth in real value-added of all sectors considered in the analysis: services, manufacturing and agriculture. For both country groups, the negative effect of a hotter spring is larger and more persistent than the positive effect of a warmer winter. Furthermore, the adverse impacts of hotter temperatures in advanced economies have accentuated in recent decades. This result suggests increased vulnerability to rising temperatures.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用大型发达经济体（AEs）和新兴市场与发展中经济体（EMDEs）样本的季度气温和部门增加值数据，本文揭示了气温对经济活动的细微影响。对于EMDEs，更热的春季和夏季气温降低了制造业，尤其是农业的实际增加值增长，而更温暖的冬季则促进了增长。对于发达国家（AEs），更热的春季损害了分析中所有部门（服务业、制造业和农业）的实际增加值增长。对于两组国家，更热春季的负面影响比更温暖冬季的正面影响更大且更持久。此外，近年来发达经济体中高温的不利影响有所加剧。这一结果表明对气温上升的脆弱性增加。

articles.title_en: Going Green: An Analysis of Mutual Fund Investment and Green Innovation in the Context of China
articles.title_cn: 走向绿色：中国背景下共同基金投资与绿色创新的分析
articles.abstract_en: Green finance is pivotal in advancing societal efforts to mitigate carbon emissions. This study examines the influence of green mutual fund investments on corporate green innovation among Chinese firms. Utilizing an extensive dataset of green patents and mutual fund portfolios, we show that firms backed by green mutual funds exhibit significantly higher levels of green innovation. This relationship is particularly pronounced in non–state-owned firms, firms with robust governance conditions, and those operating within sound institutional environments. Additionally, the positive impact is amplified when green funds are highly reputable, actively engage with portfolio firms, and are managed by women. The results are robust across various econometric models and validated by employing China’s Clean Air Action as a quasi-experiment. Overall, our findings challenge the greenwashing critique by providing empirical evidence that green investors genuinely foster environmental innovation rather than merely projecting a green image.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色金融在推动社会减缓碳排放的努力中至关重要。本研究考察了绿色共同基金投资对中国企业绿色创新的影响。利用广泛的绿色专利和共同基金组合数据集，我们表明，由绿色共同基金支持的企业表现出显著更高的绿色创新水平。这种关系在非国有企业、治理条件稳健的企业以及制度环境良好的企业中尤为明显。此外，当绿色基金声誉高、积极参与投资组合企业且由女性管理时，正面影响会增强。结果在各种计量经济学模型中均稳健，并通过采用中国的《清洁空气行动》作为准实验得到验证。总体而言，我们的发现挑战了“漂绿”批评，通过提供经验证据表明，绿色投资者真正促进环境创新，而非仅仅塑造绿色形象。

articles.title_en: Designing Carbon Pricing Policies Across the Globe
articles.abstract_en: This study presents a large-scale, multi-country assessment of expert recommendations on key policy design options for implementing carbon pricing schemes at a country level, for which there is no consensus in the literature. Based on a survey of more than 400 academic experts on carbon pricing across the globe, we find that almost twice as many favor a carbon tax over a cap-and-trade scheme for unilateral carbon pricing than vice versa, and three-quarters strongly recommend using border carbon adjustment to address competitiveness concerns. By contrast, guidance on the use of revenue from carbon pricing is much more nuanced, with considerably lower support for lump-sum transfers to households than reflected in academic and policy discussions. Furthermore, recommendations on instrument choice and revenue use vary considerably with country and expert characteristics, such as GDP per capita and academic discipline. Our findings can guide the search for suitable public policy approaches that combine environmental effectiveness with economic efficiency and fairness considerations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究对专家关于在国家层面实施碳定价方案的关键政策设计选项的建议进行了大规模、多国评估，而文献中对此尚无共识。基于对全球超过400名碳定价学术专家的调查，我们发现，对于单边碳定价，支持碳税而非总量管制与交易计划的专家人数几乎是后者的两倍，且四分之三的专家强烈建议使用边境碳调整来解决竞争力问题。相比之下，关于碳定价收入使用的指导则更为细致，对向家庭进行一次性转移支付的支持度远低于学术和政策讨论中所反映的水平。此外，关于工具选择和收入使用的建议随国家和专家特征（如人均GDP和学术学科）的不同而有显著差异。我们的发现可以指导寻找将环境有效性、经济效率和公平考虑相结合合适的公共政策方法。

articles.title_en: Environmental Taxation and Trade Policy: The Role of International Coordination in the Presence of Local Pollutants
articles.title_cn: 环境税收与贸易政策：地方污染物存在时国际协调的作用
articles.abstract_en: We examine a three-country trade model where two producer countries export a homogeneous good to a third country, and production results only in local pollution. Our contribution is at the intersection of trade and environment and we show how the trade and environmental policies interact to determine the efficacy of multilateral environmental agreements (MEA). In this context, we allow the exporting countries to cooperate either on a broad objective of improving welfare or on a narrow target of reducing pollution. We show that if the exporting countries coordinate on welfare, the net emissions and the environmental damage would be the lowest, resulting in the highest gain for the exporting countries. Interestingly, if countries coordinate only to reduce environmental damage, then the net emissions are higher than the levels when the exporting countries do not cooperate at all. Our results hold under various policy scenarios, i.e. when exporting countries utilize only a single instrument of either environmental or trade policy or both the trade and environmental policies. We also examine the implications on global welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了一个三国贸易模型，其中两个生产国向第三国出口同质商品，生产仅导致地方污染。我们的贡献在于贸易与环境交叉领域，并展示了贸易和环境政策如何相互作用以决定多边环境协议（MEA）的有效性。在此背景下，我们允许出口国在改善福利的广泛目标或减少污染的狭窄目标上进行合作。我们表明，如果出口国在福利上进行协调，净排放和环境损害将是最低的，从而为出口国带来最大收益。有趣的是，如果各国仅协调以减少环境损害，那么净排放量将高于出口国完全不合作时的水平。我们的结果在各种政策情景下均成立，即当出口国仅使用环境政策或贸易政策的单一工具，或同时使用贸易和环境政策时。我们还考察了对全球福利的影响。

articles.title_en: Lessons from the EU Effort Sharing Decision for Supranational Climate Cooperation: A Firm-Level Analysis
articles.title_cn: 欧盟努力分担决定对超国家气候合作的启示：企业层面分析
articles.abstract_en: As an example of supranational climate policy coordination for sectors not covered by carbon trading, the European Effort Sharing Decision set national targets for emission reductions for the time period 2013–2020. Member States were free to decide the national policies to implement to achieve these objectives. This is the first quantification of the impact this regulation had on the emissions of firms in the corresponding sectors. We exploit the differences along three variables: a national-level treatment intensity, an exposure index defined at the firm level and a time dimension (before or after the introduction of the policy). We find that, even in countries with no stringent target, emissions from exposed firms tended to decrease more than emissions from non-exposed firms. In addition, each percentage point increase in the stringency of the treatment leads to a 5.7% reduction in emissions for an average exposed firm. This provides interesting insights for other supranational climate agreements.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为碳交易未覆盖部门超国家气候政策协调的一个例子，欧洲努力分担决定为2013-2020年期间设定了国家减排目标。成员国可以自由决定为实现这些目标而实施的国家政策。这是首次量化该法规对相应部门企业排放影响的研究。我们利用三个变量的差异：国家层面的处理强度、企业层面定义的暴露指数以及时间维度（政策引入前后）。我们发现，即使在目标不严格的国家，暴露企业的排放减少幅度也往往大于非暴露企业。此外，处理强度每增加一个百分点，平均暴露企业的排放量就会减少5.7%。这为其他超国家气候协议提供了有趣的见解。

articles.title_en: Action Where Others Stalled: Long-Term Implications of Campaign-Style Central Environmental Inspection
articles.title_cn: 其他人停滞不前的行动：运动式中央环境督察的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: Campaign-style enforcement is a common tactic used by governments to effectively achieve specific political goals. Despite the extensive employment, campaign-style enforcement has long been criticized for its unknown long-term implications and low efficacy. This study investigates companies’ responses to campaign-style inspections represented by China’s Central Environmental Inspection (CEI). The findings indicate that the overall effects of the campaign are short-term, leading to a temporary increase in production stoppages and a decrease in pollutant concentrations when inspection teams are on-site. However, beyond these transient overall effects, we find that the CEI can effectively tackle longstanding local environmental issues by mitigating local regulatory capture and reshaping local regulatory strategies. This paper acknowledges the positive role of the central campaign in regulating pollution “hotspots,” which refutes the existing research concluding that CEI can only produce short-term effects and argues that the effectiveness of campaign-style enforcement should be explored from more diverse perspectives.
articles.abstract_cn: 运动式执法是政府有效实现特定政治目标的常用策略。尽管就业范围广泛，但运动式执法长期以来因其长期影响未知和效率低下而受到批评。本研究调查了企业对以中国中央环保督察（CEI）为代表的运动式检查的反应。调查结果表明，该行动的总体影响是短期的，导致生产停工暂时增加，检查组在现场时污染物浓度下降。然而，除了这些短暂的总体影响之外，我们发现 CEI 可以通过减轻当地监管捕获和重塑当地监管策略来有效解决长期存在的当地环境问题。本文肯定了中央专项行动在治理污染“热点”方面的积极作用，反驳了现有研究认为中央专项行动只能产生短期效应的结论，并认为应从更多元化的角度探讨专项行动的有效性。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Lead Water Pollution on Birth Outcomes: A Natural Experiment in Scotland
articles.title_cn: 铅水污染对出生结果的影响：苏格兰的自然实验
articles.abstract_en: We explore whether maternal lead exposure affects birthweights and child mortality in a setting where average blood lead levels were extremely high. We analyse two drinking water interventions in Scotland that reduced lead levels in Glasgow and Edinburgh from 1978 onwards. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design we examine administrative data of over 650,000 births between 1975 and 2000. We do not find consistent evidence of any effect leading to an increase in birthweights or a reduction in under-5 mortality. We estimate minimal detectable effects and can rule out even very low changes in birthweight, but we cannot rule out 1–3 deaths prevented per thousand due to the treatments. As our focus is on short-run outcomes around the time of birth, these findings do not rule out the possibility of longer-term impacts from early-life lead exposure. We also suggest our findings indicate future research should further explore the mediating pathways between lead and health outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了在平均血铅水平极高的环境中，母亲的铅暴露是否会影响出生体重和儿童死亡率。我们分析了苏格兰自1978以来降低格拉斯哥和爱丁堡铅含量的两项饮用水干预措施。使用交错双重差异设计，我们检查了 1975 和 2000 之间超过 650,000 出生的行政数据。我们没有发现一致的证据表明有任何影响导致出生体重增加或5以下死亡率降低。我们估计可检测到的影响最小，甚至可以排除出生体重的极低变化，但我们不能排除1-3因治疗而避免的死亡。由于我们的重点是出生时的短期结果，因此这些发现并不排除生命早期铅暴露造成长期影响的可能性。我们还建议我们的研究结果表明未来的研究应该进一步探索铅与健康结果之间的中介途径。

articles.title_en: Global Evidence on the Income Elasticity of Willingness to Pay, Relative Price Changes and Public Natural Capital Values
articles.title_cn: 全球证据：支付意愿的收入弹性、相对价格变化与公共自然资本价值
articles.abstract_en: While the global economy continues to grow, ecosystem services tend to stagnate or decline. Economic theory has shown how such shifts in relative scarcities can be reflected in project appraisal and accounting, but empirical evidence has been sparse to put theory into practice. To estimate relative price changes (RPCs) for ecosystem services to be used for making such adjustments, we perform a global meta-analysis of contingent valuation studies to derive income elasticities of marginal willingness to pay (WTP) for ecosystem services to proxy the degree of limited substitutability. Based on 735 income-WTP pairs from 396 studies, we find an income elasticity of WTP of around 0.6. Combined with good-specific growth rates, we estimate an RPC of ecosystem services of around 1.7% per year. In an application to natural capital valuation of forest ecosystem services by the World Bank, we show that natural capital should be uplifted by around 40%. Our assessment of aggregate public natural capital yields a larger value adjustment of between 58 and 97%, depending on the discount rate. We discuss implications for policy appraisal and for estimates of natural capital in comprehensive wealth accounts.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管全球经济持续增长，生态系统服务却趋于停滞或下降。经济理论已展示了这种相对稀缺性的变化如何反映在项目评估和核算中，但将理论付诸实践的实证证据一直稀缺。为了估算用于此类调整的生态系统服务相对价格变化（RPCs），我们对条件价值评估研究进行了全球元分析，以推导生态系统服务边际支付意愿（WTP）的收入弹性，作为有限替代性程度的代理指标。基于来自735项研究的396对收入-支付意愿数据，我们发现支付意愿的收入弹性约为0.6。结合特定物品的增长率，我们估算出生态系统服务的相对价格变化约为每年1.7%。在世界银行对森林生态系统服务的自然资本估值应用中，我们表明自然资本应上调约40%。我们对总公共自然资本的评估产生了更大的价值调整，介于58至97%%之间，具体取决于贴现率。我们讨论了这些发现对政策评估和综合财富账户中自然资本估算的影响。

articles.title_en: Countervailing Effects of Extreme Maximum and Minimum Temperature Days on Conflict in Mainland Southeast Asia
articles.title_cn: 极端最高和最低气温天数对东南亚大陆冲突的反向效应
articles.abstract_en: We exploit $$0.5^{\circ}\times0.5^\circ$$ raster data to document how exceedances of the local $$90^{th}$$ percentile thresholds for daily maximum and minimum temperatures affect conflict in mainland Southeast Asia. We show that conflict incidence increases with extreme high maximum temperature days and decreases with extreme high minimum temperature days. This implies that failing to control for extreme minimums understates the effects of extreme maximums. Moreover, as the frequency of extreme maximums and minimums is expected to increase together with average temperatures, the countervailing effects at both tails of the temperature distribution offset one another in mean-temperature regressions, helping to explain earlier inconclusive findings for the region. We also show that the effects of extreme maximums and minimums differ by conflict type, actors involved and affected populations. Thus, even in the absence of an aggregate mean-temperature effect, a rising frequency of extreme temperature days may generate complex distributional conflict incidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用 $$0.5^{\circ}\times0.5^\circ$$ 栅格数据，记录了每日最高和最低气温超过当地 $$90^{th}$$ 百分位阈值如何影响东南亚大陆的冲突。我们表明，冲突发生率随极端最高气温天数的增加而上升，随极端最低气温天数的增加而下降。这意味着，未能控制极端最低气温会低估极端最高气温的影响。此外，由于极端最高和最低气温的频率预计将随平均气温一同增加，温度分布两端的反向效应在平均气温回归中相互抵消，这有助于解释该地区早期不明确的发现。我们还表明，极端最高和最低气温的影响因冲突类型、涉及的参与者和受影响人群而异。因此，即使在没有总体平均气温效应的情况下，极端气温天数的频率上升也可能产生复杂的分布性冲突发生率。

articles.title_en: The Allocation of Riparian Water Rights
articles.abstract_en: We take an axiomatic approach to the allocation of riparian water rights. We formalize ethical or structural properties as axioms of allocation rules. We show that several combinations of these axioms characterize focal rules implementing the principle of Territorial Integration of all Basin States in various forms. We complete our study with an empirical application to the allocation of riparian water rights in the Nile River, which have long been in dispute.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们采用公理化方法研究河岸水权的分配问题。我们将伦理或结构性质形式化为分配规则的公理。我们证明了这些公理的若干组合刻画了以各种形式实施所有流域国领土整合原则的焦点规则。我们通过一项实证应用完成研究，该应用针对长期存在争议的尼罗河河岸水权分配问题。

articles.title_en: (Un-)scientifically Spun: Narratives, Belief Updating, and Pro-Environmental Behavior
articles.title_cn: （非）科学化叙述：叙事、信念更新与亲环境行为
articles.abstract_en: In an experiment conducted with 2346 US residents, we examine the effect of content (positive/ negative/ inconclusive) and style (scientific/unscientific) of narratives about $$\textrm{CO}_2$$ emissions on belief updating and pro-environmental behavior. We use the Work for Environmental Protection Task (WEPT) by Lange and Dewitte (Behave Res Methods 54:133–145, 2022) as a proxy for pro-environmental behavior. Narratives are constructed using the natural language processing chatbot ChatGPT. We find that negative narratives significantly increase concern regarding $$\textrm{CO}_2$$ emissions, while positive narratives significantly decrease concern, with the latter effect being significantly larger in terms of absolute value. For inconclusive narratives, the effect on beliefs depends on prior beliefs: Subjects with low prior beliefs increase their concern, whereas subjects with high prior beliefs decrease their concern. Moreover, we find that the unscientific style has a stronger effect on belief updating than the scientific style. Neither content nor style affects pro-environmental behavior significantly.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项针对2346名美国居民的实验中，我们考察了关于二氧化碳排放的叙述内容（正面/负面/不确定）和风格（科学/非科学）对信念更新和亲环境行为的影响。我们使用Lange和Dewitte（Behav Res Methods 54:133-145, 2022）提出的环境保护工作任务（WEPT）作为亲环境行为的代理指标。叙述通过自然语言处理聊天机器人ChatGPT构建。我们发现，负面叙述显著增加了对二氧化碳排放的担忧，而正面叙述显著降低了担忧，且后者的效应在绝对值上显著更大。对于不确定的叙述，对信念的影响取决于先验信念：先验信念较低的受试者担忧增加，而先验信念较高的受试者担忧减少。此外，我们发现非科学风格对信念更新的影响强于科学风格。内容和风格均未显著影响亲环境行为。

articles.title_en: Boosting Sluggish Climate Policy: Endogenous Substitution, Learning, and Energy Efficiency Improvements
articles.title_cn: 提振迟缓的气候政策：内生替代、学习与能源效率改进
articles.abstract_en: There is widespread concern that climate policy is moving too slowly and that decarbonization is coming too late for effective climate protection. We analyze three different empirically relevant effects that emerge endogenously during decarbonization and amplify climate policies: growing substitutability of dirty with clean energy inputs, learning and scale effects in renewable energies, and efficiency improvements in the application of energy. We employ the CITE simulation model, a dynamic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model with endogenous growth, to represent the macroeconomic framework of climate policy, calibrate the impacts, and obtain quantitative results. Using data from the Swiss economy, we find that improving energy substitutability is the most powerful individual mechanism. Taken together, the three mechanisms significantly shape the economy’s trajectory toward the net-zero policy target, reducing decarbonization costs by 60%. They exhibit notable synergy effects, particularly a self-reinforcing cycle between enhanced substitution and the expansion of clean energy. Implementing supportive subsidies for research and renewable energy lowers climate mitigation costs by an additional 6.5%, curtailing the overall adverse impact of climate policy on welfare from 1.0% to 0.37%.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们普遍担忧气候政策推进过于缓慢，脱碳进程对于有效的气候保护而言为时已晚。我们分析了脱碳过程中内生出现的三种不同的经验相关效应，这些效应会放大气候政策：肮脏能源投入与清洁能源投入之间替代性的增强、可再生能源中的学习效应与规模效应，以及能源应用中的效率改进。我们采用CITE模拟模型，这是一个具有内生增长的动态可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，用以代表气候政策的宏观经济框架，校准影响并获得定量结果。利用瑞士经济的数据，我们发现能源替代性的提高是最有力的单一机制。综合来看，这三种机制显著塑造了经济向净零政策目标迈进的轨迹，将脱碳成本降低了60%。它们表现出显著的协同效应，特别是增强替代与清洁能源扩张之间的自我强化循环。对研究和可再生能源实施支持性补贴，可将气候减缓成本额外降低6.5%，将气候政策对福利的总体不利影响从1.0%削减至0.37%。

articles.title_en: Technology Diffusion in Carbon Markets: Evidence from Aviation
articles.title_cn: 碳市场中的技术扩散：来自航空业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Carbon pricing has been found mainly to foster low-carbon innovation but not low-carbon technology adoption. Focusing on the aviation sector, a hard-to-abate industry, we provide novel evidence that the EU’s Emission Trading System (EU ETS) is responsible for a greater diffusion of available low-carbon technologies. By exploiting a policy change in the carbon market scope, we find a more intensive use of efficient aircraft and a sizeable effect of aircraft retrofitting – use of winglets – compared to the counterfactual, driving improvements in emission intensity. These effects, however, are not uniform: aircraft choice and retrofitting decisions differ between Eastern and Western routes. Examining the mechanisms behind our findings, we show that the more intensive use of efficient aircraft—either through fleet replacement or differential use—is the main factor driving the ETS’s effect on emission intensity. Our study highlights the importance of carbon pricing to accelerate the adoption rates of low carbon technologies, even in hard-to-abate sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳定价主要被发现能促进低碳创新，但并未促进低碳技术的采用。聚焦于航空业这一难以减排的行业，我们提供了新的证据，表明欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）促进了现有低碳技术的更广泛扩散。通过利用碳市场范围的政策变化，我们发现与反事实情况相比，高效飞机的使用更为密集，飞机改装——即使用翼梢小翼——的效果显著，从而推动了排放强度的改善。然而，这些效应并非一致：飞机选择和改装决策在东部和西部航线之间存在差异。通过考察我们发现背后的机制，我们表明高效飞机的更密集使用——无论是通过机队更换还是差异化使用——是推动ETS对排放强度影响的主要因素。我们的研究强调了碳定价在加速低碳技术采用率方面的重要性，即使在难以减排的行业也是如此。

excluded_items.title_en: Correction to: Environmental Policy Instruments for Investments in Backstop Technologies Under Present Bias - An Application to the Building Sector
